summary: First iteration test of LogiTrak 'Gestion administrative de flotte'. Backend (9/9 pytest) and frontend (all 11 critical flows) pass. Auto-seeding of 6 demo vehicles, KPI dashboard, vehicle drawer with 7 tabs, leasing edit, document folders accordion, inspection creation, timeline view toggles, fleet view admin button, and new vehicle creation all work end to end.

issues: Radix UI console warnings: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' triggered repeatedly. Functional but pollutes console and is an accessibility issue. Wrap titles in VisuallyHidden or add SheetDescription/DialogDescription where absent (e.g. NewVehicleDialog, AddInspection dialog header lacks <DialogDescription>).

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription / SheetDescription to remove Radix DialogContent warnings (NewVehicleDialog, InspectionTab AddDialog, FilePreview dialog).

Note: In Dashboard.jsx the openVehicle target tab for events of type 'expertise' or 'maintenance' falls back to 'controle' (not 'general' like TimelinePage). Consider aligning behavior for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~720 lines and is approaching the 700-line guideline; can be split into routers (vehicles, documents, inspections, storage, dashboard) as the API grows.
/api/upload and /api/vehicles/{id}/documents share ~25 lines of duplicated upload/MIME/path logic — extract a helper to DRY.
create_vehicle returns the doc cleaned but goes through dict(doc) twice; minor.
DELETE /vehicles/{id} returns 200 even when nothing was deleted (no 404 if id unknown). Consider returning 404 for unknown IDs for symmetry with GET.
Frontend Dashboard openVehicle mapping uses a chained ternary that drops 'expertise'/'maintenance' to 'controle' — TimelinePage uses tabForType which maps to 'general'. Inconsistent UX.

All file uploads are synchronous PUT to object storage via blocking 'requests' inside async endpoints — consider running in a thread pool (asyncio.to_thread / httpx async) to avoid blocking the event loop under load.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 6 demo vehicles + 2 inspections on startup. Test created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed vehicles, documents and inspections; also created and deleted 'TEST PW 001' via the UI flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 9 pytest backend tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_logitrak_api.py). Frontend public URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Object storage upload/serve round-trip works. Drawer is shared via VehicleDrawerContext and opens from Dashboard deadline rows, Vehicles plate links, Timeline events, FleetView admin buttons. Tabs in drawer use data-testid tab-general/leasing/assurance/carte-grise/etat-des-lieux/controle/documents. Inspection dialog test-ids: ins-date/ins-responsable/ins-km/ins-commentaire/ins-submit; new-vehicle-dialog uses nv-plaque/nv-marque/etc and nv-submit. Timeline views: view-month/view-quarter/view-year.
rca of the issue: No bugs found; reported items are non-blocking a11y polish and code quality observations.
